description: 全 TypeScript + Pi 在线主对话的确定性行为契约；不声称替代真实 Provider 或人工质量判断。

cases.requirement: 普通交流可以直接自然回答，不强制调用仓库工具。
cases.node_test: Pi can answer ordinary chat directly without forcing a tool call

cases.requirement: 兴趣引导、项目概览和只读证据查询不会自动修改教学进度。
cases.node_test: read-only repository tools preserve the existing teaching state

cases.requirement: 仓库源码读取必须先取得真实证据路径，并绑定当前项目与快照，按限定行数分页。
cases.node_test: conversation source reads require exposed evidence and stay bound to the snapshot

cases.requirement: 用户说讲讲图里组件时，工具使用当前 UI 选择和真实相邻关系。
cases.node_test: selected component context returns only real adjacent components

cases.requirement: 理解评估返回判断，不直接生成学习状态变更或推进进度。
cases.node_test: understanding assessment returns a judgment without a study mutation candidate

cases.requirement: 专项 Worker 结构化失败只返回稳定原因，不泄露 Provider、Prompt 或堆栈。
cases.node_test: structured worker failure returns a stable reason without provider details

cases.requirement: 不存在的组件和关系失败关闭，不能暴露或升级证据。
cases.node_test: fabricated graph identifiers fail closed without exposing evidence

cases.requirement: 不存在的路径和越界行号不能成为回答证据。
cases.node_test: citation validation accepts real lines and rejects fabricated locations

cases.requirement: 在线 Pi 工具目录不包含 Shell、数据库、任意写文件或任意执行。
cases.node_test: online tool catalog contains no shell database or arbitrary file capability

cases.requirement: 未验证的回答连同引用提示保留在后续会话中，但不提升为可信长期记忆。
cases.node_test: conversation service keeps the displayed unverified reply in the next Pi requests

cases.requirement: 已经取消的请求不会继续调用 Provider 或污染 Session。
cases.node_test: Pi runtime does not contact the provider when already cancelled

cases.requirement: Pi Session 可以跨进程式重启恢复。
cases.node_test: Pi session survives a process-style reopen

cases.requirement: Pi 原生 compaction entry 会作为摘要上下文恢复。
cases.node_test: Pi compaction entry is restored as a native summary message

cases.requirement: 长期记忆只接受有用户原文依据的稳定信息并拒绝凭证。
cases.node_test: memory maintenance keeps sourced learning facts and rejects secrets

cases.requirement: MCP 通过 Bearer 暴露六个共享 TypeScript 领域工具，不复制 Agent 编排。
cases.node_test: MCP exposes the six shared TypeScript product tools behind Bearer auth

cases.requirement: 代码讲解由 Primary 完成，在线工具只暴露一个学习动作提议入口。
cases.node_test: online conversation tools keep explanation in Primary and expose one action proposal tool

cases.requirement: 学习动作只生成待确认卡片，确认前不修改学习状态。
cases.node_test: propose_learning_action creates a pending card without changing study state

cases.requirement: 只有伪造证据支持的 mastered 评估不能完成，也不能修改学习状态。
cases.node_test: understanding assessment rejects mastered results supported only by fabricated evidence

cases.requirement: 学习动作提议拒绝当前快照中不存在的目标。
cases.node_test: learning action proposal rejects fabricated targets

cases.requirement: 证据不足时可以返回空路线，不产生学习状态候选。
cases.node_test: learning route may return an honest empty result
